content:
[C] high | whole lower screen: ~55% of the window is a raw black void below the content, reading as a crashed/unfinished render rather than a designed empty state.
[C] high | full canvas: all content is crammed into the left ~350px column while the remaining ~1400px of width is completely empty, producing a grotesquely unbalanced composition.
[C] med | bottom of content area: a "Run initial sync" primary button and "Mark complete" secondary button sit flush against the Setup checklist card edge-to-edge with no grouping container, reading as floating debug controls.
[S] med | buttons vs. checklist card: the buttons touch/overlap the bottom margin of the white card with zero breathing room, while the status card below has a visible gap — inconsistent vertical rhythm.
[H] med | status card (bottom left): two lines of equal-weight small gray text ("Onboarding is not marked complete yet." / "No Help Scout credentials yet…") give no status icon, color, or hierarchy — it reads like a console log dump, not a status panel.
[H] med | Setup checklist card: step numbers, titles, and descriptions all near the same size and weight; only the "Done" green dot distinguishes step 2 — heading vs. body distinction is weak.
[L] low | checklist card left edge: the gray/green step dots are half-clipped, hanging off the card's inner left padding and touching the card border.
[S] low | window edges: content inset from the top-left is minimal (~8px), while huge dead space surrounds everything else — inconsistent margins.
[C] low | header region: "Welcome to SupportOS+" title and its subtitle have no breathing room below before the card, and the header occupies the full width while the body uses only 25% — two different grids.
[H] low | card headers vs. body: "Setup checklist" heading is barely larger than its supporting text; nothing on screen establishes a clear type scale.

VERDICT: unprofessional — a mostly-black window with a tiny cluster of under-hierarchied controls in the corner looks like a debug build, not a helpdesk product.

Defect-free note: the checklist card's internal text itself has no truncation or overlap.
